title: 真实Grafana副本解密恢复：健康节点仍200，只对齐故障节点原密钥
answer:
```python
import pathlib,re
def align_key(source,target):
    source,target=pathlib.Path(source),pathlib.Path(target)
    if any(p.is_symlink() or not p.is_file() for p in (source,target)) or source.resolve()==target.resolve():raise ValueError('two separate real private configs required')
    origin=source.read_text(encoding='utf8');destination=target.read_text(encoding='utf8')
    values=re.findall(r'(?m)^secret_key[ \t]*=[ \t]*([^\r\n]+)$',origin)
    if len(values)!=1 or not values[0].strip() or len(re.findall(r'(?m)^secret_key[ \t]*=',destination))!=1:raise ValueError('one explicit private key per controlled config required')
    key=values[0].strip()
    target.write_text(re.sub(r'(?m)^secret_key[ \t]*=[^\r\n]*$',lambda match:'secret_key = '+key,destination),encoding='utf8')
```

原题知识说明：
关联请求节点与加密配置，确认共享数据库的秘密用原密钥保护。恢复正确受控密钥及相关配置，不生成替代随机值覆盖旧秘密。验证所有节点查询与重启后解密，轮换须走支持流程。

conversion.original_title: 多实例随机报数据源密码解密失败，失败只落在新节点，其secret_key不同。如何处置？

body:
## 操作任务
实现align_key(source,target)，在两个独立私有Grafana配置中，只把故障副本target的唯一secret_key行对齐健康节点source原有值。题面配置每个只含一行该设置；必须保留source逐字节内容、target所有其他行和双方0600权限；两条路径须为不同真实文件，symlink、缺失或重复密钥行ValueError且不写文件。不得用admin_password、任意新密钥、重写数据源明文或批量重新加密绕过。夹具用真实Grafana加密保存的数据源BasicAuth凭据：健康节点代理请求200，错密钥节点还原出错误的非空凭据并被后端拒绝（不假定一定抛显式解密异常）；修复并重启故障节点后两个节点都向受保护后端发出正确认证请求，数据源密文及默认登录身份保持。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Grafana11.6.0双私有进程、同一临时SQLite密文及loopback认证后端，只验证副本密钥不一致导致的解密失败与恢复。SQLite共享仅为受控密文复现，不宣称生产HA支持、跨机集群或密钥轮换方案完整；不触碰宿主默认账号/配置、不改变权限、不部署、不构建镜像。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import base64,hashlib,http.server,json,os,pathlib,re,secrets,sqlite3,sys,threading
sys.path[:0]=[os.getcwd(),str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks')]
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
import task
from grafana_native import PrivateGrafana
password=secrets.token_hex(20);expected='Basic '+base64.b64encode(('training-reader:'+password).encode()).decode();accepted=[];rejected=[]
class Backend(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
 def do_GET(self):
  valid=self.headers.get('Authorization')==expected
  if valid:accepted.append(self.path)
  else:
   encoded=self.headers.get('Authorization','').removeprefix('Basic ')
   try:identity,separator,credential=base64.b64decode(encoded).partition(b':')
   except ValueError:identity,separator,credential=b'',b'',b''
   rejected.append(dict(path=self.path,user_matches=identity==b'training-reader',password_matches=credential==password.encode(),password_nonempty=bool(credential)))
  self.send_response(200 if valid else 401);self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json');self.end_headers()
  self.wfile.write(json.dumps(dict(status='success',data=dict(resultType='vector',result=[])) if valid else dict(error='unauthorized')).encode())
 def log_message(self,*args):pass
backend=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),Backend);thread=threading.Thread(target=backend.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
def call(server,method,path,body=None):
 code,value=server.request(method,path,body);assert code==200,(method,path,code,value);return value
def principal(server):
 user=call(server,'GET','/api/user');return {k:user[k] for k in ('id','login','orgId','isGrafanaAdmin')}
try:
 with PrivateGrafana() as first:
  uid='source-'+secrets.token_hex(5);url='http://127.0.0.1:'+str(backend.server_port)
  call(first,'POST','/api/datasources',dict(uid=uid,name='Protected auth '+secrets.token_hex(4),type='prometheus',access='proxy',url=url,basicAuth=True,basicAuthUser='training-reader',secureJsonData=dict(basicAuthPassword=password)))
  route='/api/datasources/proxy/uid/'+uid+'/api/v1/query?query=up'
  assert call(first,'GET',route)['status']=='success' and len(accepted)==1 and not rejected
  source_bytes=first.config.read_bytes();identity=principal(first)
  def ciphertext():
   connection=sqlite3.connect('file:'+str(first.root/'grafana.db')+'?mode=ro',uri=True)
   try:
    row=connection.execute('select id,uid,secure_json_data from data_source where uid=?',(uid,)).fetchone();assert row
    value=row[2].encode() if isinstance(row[2],str) else bytes(row[2]);return row[:2]+(hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest(),)
   finally:connection.close()
  encrypted_before=ciphertext()
  def prepare_second(second):
   text=second.config.read_text();text=text.replace(str(second.root/'grafana.db'),str(first.root/'grafana.db'))
   text=text.replace('admin_user = '+second.user,'admin_user = '+first.user).replace('admin_password = '+second.password,'admin_password = '+first.password)
   second.config.write_text(text);second.user=first.user;second.password=first.password
  with PrivateGrafana(prepare_second) as second:
   original_target=second.config.read_bytes();assert principal(second)==identity
   assert call(second,'GET','/api/datasources/uid/'+uid)['secureJsonFields']['basicAuthPassword'] is True
   assert not rejected,'no background backend request may contaminate controlled failure'
   status,value=second.request('GET',route)
   assert 400<=status<=599 and len(accepted)==1 and len(rejected)==1,'wrong-key node must fail a real protected backend request'
   assert rejected[0]==dict(path='/api/v1/query?query=up',user_matches=True,password_matches=False,password_nonempty=True),'same datasource username but incorrect nonempty restored credential required'
   failure_requests=len(rejected)
   assert call(first,'GET',route)['status']=='success' and len(accepted)==2 and len(rejected)==failure_requests,'original node must remain healthy'
   assert ciphertext()==encrypted_before
   print('NATIVE_GRAFANA_SAME_CIPHERTEXT_HEALTHY_NODE200_BAD_KEY_NODE_WRONG_NONEMPTY_CREDENTIAL_REJECTED',flush=True)
   print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:align_only_bad_replica_secret_key_keep_original_identity_ciphertext',flush=True)
   try:task.align_key(first.config,second.config)
   except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('private replica key alignment failed') from error
   after_target=second.config.read_bytes()
   def without_key(value):return re.sub(rb'(?m)^secret_key[ \t]*=[^\r\n]*$',b'secret_key = <same-field>',value)
   assert without_key(after_target)==without_key(original_target) and first.config.read_bytes()==source_bytes,'unapproved config or healthy source changed'
   assert second.config.stat().st_mode&0o777==first.config.stat().st_mode&0o777==0o600
   second.stop();second.start()
   assert call(second,'GET',route)['status']=='success' and len(accepted)==3 and len(rejected)==failure_requests
   assert call(first,'GET',route)['status']=='success' and len(accepted)==4 and len(rejected)==failure_requests
   assert principal(first)==principal(second)==identity and ciphertext()==encrypted_before
   assert first.config.read_bytes()==source_bytes and second.config.read_bytes()==after_target
   link=second.root/'linked.ini';link.symlink_to(first.config)
   try:task.align_key(first.config,link)
   except ValueError:pass
   else:raise AssertionError('symlink target accepted')
   assert first.config.read_bytes()==source_bytes and second.config.read_bytes()==after_target
   print('NATIVE_GRAFANA_BAD_NODE_RESTART_DECRYPTS_OLD_SECRET_BOTH_BACKENDS_AUTH200_NO_CIPHERTEXT_IDENTITY_CHANGE',flush=True)
finally:backend.shutdown();backend.server_close();thread.join(timeout=2)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
